units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country located in Western Europe with a population of ⟦1⟧ (core) and an additional ⟦2⟧ (non-core). It borders the ⟦3⟧ to the north, ⟦4⟧ to the east, ⟦5⟧ to the southeast, and ⟦6⟧ to the southwest. Through its colony of Congo in Central Africa, it also borders the ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧. With the ⟦9⟧ DLC enabled, Congo is made into a ⟦10⟧ of Belgium, called ⟦11⟧.

Since independence in 1830, ⟦0⟧ had retained a policy of staunch neutrality similar to that of ⟦1⟧. However, this neutrality was not respected by others and ⟦2⟧ neutrality was violated by the German Empire, after an invasion, in 1914 causing the ⟦3⟧ to declare war on the German Empire. The Germans initially steamrolled through most of the country and Northern France, and by the time trench-warfare kicked in the frontlines had completely stagnated leaving ⟦4⟧ a shadow of its former self. The war caused serious devastation to the Belgium countryside and economy all for a war they were forced into. Because of this, ⟦5⟧ left the war seeking revenge and so annexed the border region of Eupen-Malmedy but much like ⟦6⟧, they were dissatisfied with the Versailles settlement believing that Germany could have been treated harsher.

Unsurprisingly, still not content ⟦0⟧ became a major participant of the occupation of the Ruhr from 1923-25, in a naive attempt by members of the now all but dismantled Entente to force Germany to pay their reparations. Despite this brief hiccup ⟦1⟧ continued to pioneer its neutrality well into the 1930s, angering ⟦2⟧ who wanted to use the country as a staging-ground to counter possible German aggression. While on the other hand the ⟦3⟧ sit eager to launch an invasion through the country to get to the French capital of Paris.

All this leaves ⟦0⟧ with paramount weight on its shoulders as its involvement, or rather lack of involvement, could sway the ever closer war to one sides advantage. The argument for some is between neutrality or sovereignty.

⟦0⟧ gets a unique national focus tree as part of the ⟦1⟧ expansion. Without the expansion, Belgium utilizes the ⟦2⟧.
The Belgian national focus tree can be divided into 6 branches and 8 sub-branches:
The beginning of the army and political branch declares Belgium as neutral and calls for a snap election in order to decide Belgium's new leadership.
This builds up Belgium's defensive capabilities in ⟦0⟧ on both sides of the border and defensive modifiers on the states..
The army sub-branch gives military industry and army modifiers and research bonuses.
This side of the political branch forces the King to choose the country's leadership during a government stalemate.

The historical path allows Belgium to remove it's economic woes and corruption. It may thencreate the Benelux union, which will then form the European Union, which allows it to from the ⟦0⟧. Or instead it can remove ⟦1⟧ and its neutral stance.

The ⟦0⟧ sub-branch has 2 main paths. The leftmost path allows the Rexists into power, choose a national language, and get industrial bonuses. The rightmost path brings the Vlaamsch Nationaal Verbond into power and changes Belgium into various cosmetic nations, from ⟦1⟧, to ⟦2⟧ to ⟦3⟧ and finally to ⟦4⟧. It can then gain the rest of the low countries, and the ⟦5⟧ colonies, and further expand into ⟦6⟧. The central section abandons neutrality, rebuild the economy, give army bonuses and makes King Leopold into a field marshal. Belgium will then not surrender when invaded.
The ⟦0⟧ path builds more defenses in Belgium and builds a . Belgium will call for a ⟦1⟧ in order to decide if it will go ⟦2⟧ and join the Allies or ⟦3⟧.
Raise the Red Flag/Soviet Guarantee/Support the European Project Sub-branch
The shared ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ path allows Belgium to join the Comintern, or create the beginnings of a European Union to form the ⟦2⟧.
The ⟦0⟧ branch builds industry, choose a language, support the ⟦1⟧ in their civil war, and expand ⟦2⟧ into Africa from the ⟦3⟧.
The industrial branch gives bonuses for Belgium's civilian industry and reduces ⟦0⟧ penalty.
The joint branch shared with ⟦0⟧. It mainly builds industry within the Congo region, builds up the Force Publique, and sets the future of the ⟦1⟧.
The air force branch builds up Belgium's air force, and gives helicopter research bonuses.
The naval branch builds up Belgium's naval industry and technology.

The Belgium in exile branch is available when Belgium surrenders and becomes a government in exile. The left side removes the king from leading the nation and builds up Belgium's strength and legitimacy in exile. It may then become a republic, reinstall Leopold to the throne, or install his brother, Charles. The right side is the ⟦0⟧ path. It builds Belgium's military in exile and state resistance against the enemy nation.
The joint Congo focus tree has 6 main sections:
Builds civilian and military factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants extra research slots. Can only be done by the ⟦0⟧.
Builds civilian and fuel factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants national spirits. Can only be done by ⟦0⟧.

Builds civilian, infrastructure and expands on natural resources, including on Rwanda-Burundi. The building up the Congo's resources tends to increase the ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧, while several focuses on the right will decrease autonomy. The player may decide to expand the ⟦2⟧ with war goals for the ⟦3⟧ and other surrounding African states.

Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research, and additional generals that can be unlocked by said focus. It also modifies the ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. This sub-branch is available to the ⟦2⟧ only if it is at war as a Belgian puppet.

Builds civilian industry, naval industry, infrastructure and expands the uranium industry and nuclear research. The focuses that give nuclear bonuses will increase ⟦0⟧ while the focuses on the right of the section will decrease it.
Congo's Place in the World Sub-branch

This section decides on the future of the ⟦0⟧ depending on the the ⟦1⟧ of the colony. If it is an ⟦2⟧ or a ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ may decide to Annex the ⟦5⟧. If it is an ⟦6⟧, a ⟦7⟧, a ⟦8⟧, or a ⟦9⟧, the ⟦10⟧ will become an ⟦11⟧ or a ⟦12⟧ and may not increase its autonomy. The ⟦13⟧ may permanently stay as a ⟦14⟧ or a ⟦15⟧. Or the ⟦16⟧ may negotiate to become ⟦17⟧. If it follows this path, it may form an ⟦18⟧ faction with other independent African nations, or gain war goals on surrounding African states to help it form the ⟦19⟧.
